layouts.name: Curborough
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Open single-lap sprint follows Startline Straight, Woodside, the eastern loop and Shenstone Straight to the finish. The operator course plan identifies the 831 m single-lap route; the independent source-node selection measures 827.9 m. The catalogue scalar 983 m and diagram include untimed approach/run-on areas. Those areas and the alternate Flagpole connector are excluded from the timed draft; both endpoint nodes agree with private start and finish gates. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 827.9 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
